ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 服务端未知错误,请携带 request_id 联系支持
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Unknown server-side error; contact support with the request id

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 服务端严重错误,请携带 request_id 联系支持
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Fatal server-side error; contact support with the request id

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 认证失败:API Key 无效或区域不匹配(国内 Key 打了海外 API?),运行 tripo doctor 自动诊断
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Authentication failed: invalid key or wrong region (cn key against the ov API?) — run "tripo doctor" to auto-diagnose

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 请求体格式不合法
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The request body is malformed

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 一个或多个参数不合法,请对照文档检查
ERROR_CATALOG.en: One or more parameters are invalid (check the docs)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 无权访问该资源,请检查账号权限
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Not allowed to access this resource (check permissions)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 请求过于频繁,触发全局速率限制
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Rate limit exceeded — too many requests in a short time

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 触发生成并发上限,同系列任务共享并发池
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Generation concurrency limit hit (task families share a pool)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 任务不存在(确认任务属于当前 Key、区域正确)
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Task not found (same key that created it? right region?)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 该任务类型不受支持
ERROR_CATALOG.en: This task type is not supported

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 输入图片文件为空,请检查文件是否损坏
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The image file is empty (corrupted upload?)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 不支持的图片文件类型
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Unsupported image file type

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: draft 任务不是成功状态,请用成功的任务重试
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The draft task is not a success; retry with a successful one

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 上游任务类型不受支持,请检查任务链
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The original task type is not supported for this operation

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 上游任务不是成功状态
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The original task has not succeeded

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 输入违反内容政策,请更换输入
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Input violates the content policy; change the input

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: prompt 含有非法字符,请修改后重试
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The prompt contains invalid characters

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 积分不足
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Insufficient credits

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: rig-check 的输入任务没有模型产物
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The rig-check input task has no model output

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: retarget 只接受 rig 任务作为输入
ERROR_CATALOG.en: retarget only accepts a rig task as input

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: priority 取值无效(更高优先级需联系支持)
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Invalid priority (contact support for higher priority)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 内容审核过程出错,请联系支持
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Error occurred during content auditing; contact support

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 模型版本已弃用,请升级 model 参数
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Model version deprecated; upgrade the model parameter

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 该请求类型已弃用,请改用其他类型
ERROR_CATALOG.en: This request type is deprecated; use an alternative

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: model 版本取值无效
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The model version value is invalid

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 模型太复杂无法重网格化,降低 face_limit 或简化输入
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Model too complex to remesh; lower face_limit or simplify input

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 文件不存在,请确认上传是否成功、file_token 是否过期
ERROR_CATALOG.en: File not found (upload succeeded? token expired?)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 图片 URL 无效,请确认可公开访问
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The image URL is invalid (must be publicly reachable)

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 文件大小超过上限,请压缩后重试
ERROR_CATALOG.en: File size exceeds the limit; reduce and retry

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 图片尺寸超过上限,请缩小后重试
ERROR_CATALOG.en: Image size exceeds the limit; reduce and retry

ERROR_CATALOG.zh: 请求的接口不存在,请检查 API 路径
ERROR_CATALOG.en: The requested endpoint does not exist (check the API path)
